# v2.28-dev Release Notes

## Fixed: Offerings admin links

The **Offerings** admin page was reachable but not linked from the usual admin
navigation. It now appears where you'd expect:

- **Admin submenu** in the sidebar — a new **Offerings** entry (under Program
  Data).
- **Admin overview** page (`/admin`) — a new **Offerings** card.

Both open the existing `/admin/offerings` management page (SuperAdmin only). No
database changes.

No action needed after updating.
